subject: Immediate: production latency spike impacting Helix AI (p95/p99)
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@helix.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helix SRE <sre@helix.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Production latency spike affecting Helix AI - p95/p99 up since 08:05 UTC

Hi Karthik / Laura,

We started seeing a sharp increase in inference latency around 08:05 UTC this morning for our EU tenant (helix-prod-eu). Key observations:
- p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~640ms; p99 up to ~1.2s.
- Error rate (5xx) rose from ~0.3% to ~2.4%.
- Overall throughput dropped ~30% for the helix-prod-eu key.

We have attached a screenshot of our Grafana panel (p95_dashboard.png) and a lightweight packet/log capture (support_log.tar.gz). Our initial traceroutes suggest traffic is being routed to an APAC egress for some percentage of requests — we see hops that terminate in ap-southeast instead of eu-west-1. This started promptly after the 07:58 config push on your side (per our monitoring).

This is customer-facing production impact — our ML predictions back offices are timing out, and our SREs are fielding alerts from multiple services. We need immediate mitigation and an ETA for resolution. If this needs executive attention, please escalate — we will need a post-incident summary.

Thanks,
Priya
SRE Manager, Helix AI

Attachments: p95_dashboard.png, support_log.tar.gz
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@helix.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Production latency spike affecting Helix AI - p95/p99 up since 08:05 UTC

Priya — thank you for the details and the quick signal. We're treating this as a Sev-1.

Immediate actions I’ve kicked off:
1) Marissa and infra on call to validate regional egress mappings and recent routing policy changes (I think the 07:58 push is suspect).
2) Rishi to validate model-serving placement and whether smart-routing fallbacks are misclassifying EU traffic as APAC.
3) Temporarily disabling smart cross-region routing for the Helix tenant (if safe) to force egress to eu-west-1 while we investigate.
4) I'll loop in the on-call director and prepare an exec note for Helix leadership.

Please hold any internal mitigations on your side until we confirm, so we don't cause flapping. I will update in 15–20 minutes with a mitigation plan.

—Karthik
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Production latency spike affecting Helix AI - p95/p99 up since 08:05 UTC

Karthik / team — infra triage notes below (summary first):
- Root cause candidate: mis-tagged egress mapping in the regional routing table that causes ~27% of EU customer flows to be re-routed to APAC egress nodes.
- When did it happen: a config push at 07:58 UTC applied an updated egress-profile that included an APAC CIDR entry without the eu-west-1 tag.
- Symptoms: traceroutes from Helix requests show an extra AS hop into ap-southeast edge, and we see RTT increase consistent with transcontinental hop.

Relevant excerpts and attached logs: egress-mapping-dump.log (attached). See lines:
> route_id=xyz123 applied_profile=egress-v2 tag=ap-southeast priority=100
> route_id=xyz123 applied_profile=egress-v2 tag=eu-west-1 priority=50  <-- missing, fallback to ap-southeast

Immediate mitigation applied at 08:34 UTC: rolled back the 07:58 egress-profile to previous version for helix-prod-eu and pinned their tenant to eu-west-1. Early telemetry shows p95 trending back down (current ~180ms) and error rate decreasing. We will keep pinning for 1 hour while we validate.

Next steps:
- Full rollback audit and postmortem (Rishi / infra)
- Confirm why the egress-profile accepted APAC CIDR without region tag (validation gap)
- Exec note and customer-facing summary (Karthik + Laura)

Attachments: egress-mapping-dump.log

—Marissa
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Production latency spike affecting Helix AI - p95/p99 up since 08:05 UTC

Quick technical summary / temporary workarounds we applied:
- Verified that model-serving placement for Helix was healthy in eu-west-1; the latency spike was network egress related, not model hot-spotting.
- Disabled smart cross-region routing for helix-prod-eu at 08:36 UTC (config id: sr-disable-427) so requests are forced to local egress.
- Rolled back egress-profile as Marissa noted.
- Deployed a short-lived routing validation check to block profile pushes that contain CIDRs without a region tag (will ship a policy-by-default in the next patch).

Impact metrics as of 09:00 UTC:
- p95: 180ms (down from 640ms)
- p99: 400ms (down from 1.2s)
- 5xx rate: 0.6% (down from 2.4%)

I'll own the postmortem and remediation items: validation rule, tighter rollout gates, and a runbook update for rapid tenant pinning. We'll also prepare an exec summary for Helix leadership.

—Rishi
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@helix.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Production latency spike affecting Helix AI - p95/p99 up since 08:05 UTC

Priya — thanks again for flagging and for the logs. Quick customer update: 
- We identified a mis-tagged egress profile pushed at 07:58 UTC that caused a subset of EU traffic for Helix to be routed via APAC, increasing RTT and p95/p99.
- Mitigation completed: we rolled back the profile and disabled smart cross-region routing for your tenant at 08:36 UTC. Early metrics show p95/p99 and error rate returning to normal.
- Next steps: Rishi will lead the postmortem and remediation (validation-rule and rollout gate). We will prepare a written incident report and share within 48 hours.

As a goodwill gesture for the production impact, we'd like to offer a one-time service credit for Helix (TBD) — Laura, can you draft the credit offer and corresponding paperwork?

Can we schedule a 30-minute follow-up with your engineering leadership at 14:00 UTC today to walk through the root cause and remediation? If that works, please confirm and we'll send a calendar invite.

Apologies for the disruption — we know this hit at a bad time. We'll get you a full summary.

—Karthik
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
